relationships.subject: TRKA+ sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic inhibition reversed allodynia and pricking and cold hyperalgesia, as well as joint pain behavior, limb dysfunction and paw dexterity deficits during and after inflammation

relationships.subject: GFRA3+ C-nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: Silencing GFRA3+ neurons in Gfra3ArchT mice reversed allodynia and pricking and cold hyperalgesia during and after inflammation

relationships.subject: type 1 interferon
relationships.evidence_quote: IFN1 receptor (IFNAR1/IFNAR2) activation phosphorylates STAT1 and STAT2 and recruits IRF9 to form ISGF3, which drives ISG expression

key_findings: Cartilage autoantibodies cause C-fiber hyperexcitability and pain before, during and after arthritis; silencing GFRA3+ (PEP1) neurons reverses pain.
DRG shows rapid type 1 interferon response and cytokine storm driven by vascular cells and monocytes/macrophages.
